make_or_buy_basis: A small adapter family attaches seats, handrails, PIS, CCTV and cable supports to the common rail without unique body brackets.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: passivated or coated surfaces, electrically/galvanically isolated interfaces and cleanable snag-free passenger edges
material_spec.form_factor: common rail-side saddle blank CNC-trimmed/drilled into seat, handrail and equipment variants without transferring primary loads through trim panels
material_spec.governing_standard: fixture-specific released load calculation/drawing plus material, fastener, fire, corrosion, proof-load and passenger-safety evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: laser-cut/folded 304/316 or coated S355 saddles with radiused edges, anti-rotation keys, isolators and M8 captive/floating joints
material_spec.material_family: calculated passenger-fixture saddle and adapter family
material_spec.nominal_section: rail engagement, edge radius, anti-rotation feature, hole/slot range and fixture keep-out fixed by the controlled adapter drawing
material_spec.traceability: material/finish batch, adapter variant, fastener lot, installed position map, torque/locking record and first-article proof test

joining_methods: fixture tack and weld where structural
process_spec.release_level: v2A drawing-controlled MAKE process; generated traveler is unsigned until build

title: standard passenger-fixture saddle and equipment adapter kit
